Bandwidth.description_en:
The inter-region bandwidth allocated to the current queue when the bandwidth guarantee type is set to absolute value mode.

For example, a value of 1 indicates that traffic packets matching the current queue can use up to 1 Mbit/s of inter-region bandwidth
Bandwidth.description_zh:
带宽保障类型为按绝对值模式时，当前队列分配跨地域带宽的值。

例如，1表示符合当前队列的流量报文最多只能使用1Mbps的跨地域带宽

Dscps.description_en: The DSCP values matched by the current queue

items.description_en: The DSCP values matched by the current queue

EffectiveBandwidth.description_en: The actual effective bandwidth value of the current queue
EffectiveBandwidth.description_zh: 当前队列实际生效的带宽值

RemainBandwidthPercent.description_en:
The percentage of inter-region bandwidth that the current queue can use when the bandwidth guarantee type is set to percentage mode.

For example, a value of 1 indicates that traffic packets matching the current queue can use up to 1% of the inter-region bandwidth
RemainBandwidthPercent.description_zh:
带宽保障类型为按百分比模式时，当前队列可使用的跨地域带宽的百分比。

例如，1表示符合当前队列的流量报文最多只能使用1%的跨地域带宽
